summary: VivoPower PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing a feasibility study for integrating a battery energy storage system at its Mo i Rana data center in Norway. The study targets up to USD 4 million incremental annualized EBITDA from participation in Nordic reserve markets. No deal terms, offer prices, or special-situation event like a merger, tender offer, or restructuring are present. This is an operational update regarding a potential project, not a special situation under the required categories. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report on business developments.
